description: Full_Name stores a person's full name as a free‑text string. All 30 records are non‑null and unique. The column mixes Western name order with South/Southeast Asian patronymic markers such as "d/o", "s/o", "Binte", and "Bin". A few entries appear in all lower‑case (e.g., "junrong", "irfan"), showing inconsistent capitalization.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Standardise deterministic case‑only deviations to title case, e.g., 'junrong' → 'Junrong', 'irfan' → 'Irfan', 'Lee yixuan' → 'Lee Yixuan'.
[CLARIFY] Confirm how patronymic suffixes (d/o, s/o, Binte, Bin) should be handled—whether they remain in the full name field or need to be parsed into separate relationship fields.
